title.th: นำร่องน้ำท่วมกรุงเทพฯ
กรุงเทพฯ ทั้งหมด (50 เขต)

demo_corridor.chosen: Product Owner, 3 October 2026 (Bang Sue and Chatuchak); Bang Kapi and Lat Krabang added the same day; whole Bangkok on 4 October 2026

rain_areas.note: District rain stays on the first four demo districts to keep Longdo Weather calls flat; the busiest active incidents anywhere in Bangkok still get their own rain.

exposure.note: Display thresholds for the demo, not validated rules. near_m: a flooded road this close makes a facility potentially exposed. frontage_m: a closed or truck-risky road this close puts access under review.

retention.note: ADR-0045. Raw downloads and report IDs older than raw_days are removed (fetch rows and SHA-256 stay); per-snapshot facility states older than exposure_days are deleted. Observations, incidents and events are kept.

sources.purpose: Road flood state and Floodboard's per-vehicle verdict
sources.quality_notes: A fusion of Traffy, crowd reports and BMA sensors. No feature IDs; GRP identifies a segment by a hash of its geometry. Features marked zone, estimated, inferred or cluster are Floodboard's own derivations. The verdict is Floodboard's estimate, not a BMA rule.

sources.purpose: Point reports behind the road states, about the last 24 hours
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 for the export; quoted text may carry other terms
sources.pii: Report text and links can identify people. GRP keeps only a hash of the text and never displays it.
sources.redistribution: Export allowed with attribution; quoted text not cleared
sources.quality_notes: Each row names its underlying source (traffy, crowd, bma_sensor, bma_dds, news). A sensor keeps one ID across readings.

sources.dataset: Traffic events feed: flood events only
sources.purpose: Independent flood reports, mostly official Department of Highways (DOH) road status
sources.license: Not stated; credit Longdo Traffic, DOH and iTIC
sources.attribution: Longdo Traffic event feed (DOH, iTIC and Longdo users)
sources.coverage: Thailand; GRP keeps the Bangkok region
sources.pii: Contributor names can be usernames: only a source family is kept. Description text is kept as a hash.
sources.quality_notes: Flood events only (icon 'flood'). 'Passable' means flooded but passable, never dry. Times are Bangkok time; expired events are dropped.
